::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 30 [1897]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Cheltenham Ladies College 0942
:::

Dear [Madam](people/person_2166.qmd)
I am very sorry I cannot help you to [Ben Sylvester](cmy_books/cmybook_25.qmd).  I have not even one of my own except in a bound up volume, and the copyright is not mine.  But if you enquired for it direct from [Innes](people/person_744.qmd)they might find a last copy, or be stirred to a reprint.

yours truly
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Endorsed in another hand ‘from Miss A.H.Walker, Wokingham’, with envelope addressed to 'Mrs Walker/ Gordon Boys Home/ Woking.' postmarked 30 March 1897.
